title: Findings of the fact-check passes
description: One record per finding of a review pass in report 31. The id is the pass and the finding's number in that pass, so RES-02.06-16 is RES-02's sixteenth finding on report 06, and a letter tells apart two findings a pass gave one number. A folded finding carries the phrases that show its change in the tree today, so a later edit that undoes a correction fails the docs check.

subject.description: The reports or records the pass named for the finding, as it named them.

severity.description: The pass's label, defined in report 31. ARC-01 and IMP-01 gave none.

change.description: What the pass changed, as it recorded it.

status.description: folded: the change holds in the tree, shown by evidence. superseded: a later decision or rewrite replaced the text the finding was about, said in by. open: the question it raised is unanswered, named in question.

files.description: The files the change lives in today.

question.description: The open question of report 30 that carries the finding.
